source_receipt.role: the same archived path independently reconstructs every initial guess; no grid-case warm starts or old matching residuals

formulation.endpoint_equations: unchanged EXP-475 ordered-Schur eigenspace projections and two equal endpoint-radius gauges
formulation.parameterization: bounded tanh transformations; saturation cannot pass interiority gate
formulation.discretization: SciPy solve_bvp fourth-order adaptive collocation; unchanged analytic state/parameter Jacobians and centered transformed-parameter boundary derivative
formulation.independence: same model and EXP-342 initial trajectory; different boundary formulation/discretization from EXP-342, same formulation as EXP-475
formulation.trajectory_identity_limit: same seed and nearby parameter do not prove trajectory identity or uniqueness

analytic_controls.model: x'=y, y'=x-x^3+mu*y; exact mu=0 homoclinic x=sqrt(2)*sech(t), y=-sqrt(2)*sech(t)*tanh(t)
analytic_controls.negative_control: mu constrained to [0.03,0.07] must be numerically rejected; H'=mu*y^2 injects energy. Timeout, exception, or node-cap exhaustion does not qualify as rejection.

budget.deadline_scope: cooperative callbacks/checks; each target case covers independent seed construction, collocation, and replay; controls and all cases share total deadline; no hard factorization preemption
budget.hardware: local CPU only; no paid resources

refinement.endpoint_classification_order: below_declared_empirical_resolution if radius difference and summed D2 are each <=1e-9; otherwise resolved if summed D2 <=0.25*radius difference; otherwise unresolved. Failed/missing cases are unavailable.

claim_scope: The overall pass requires all nine technical cases and fixed-radius discretization gates. Endpoint-effect resolution is a separate reported outcome. Finite-radius solution paths are retained even when replay or comparison fails, and later cases stop after the first technical failure. No parameter-box, tolerance, or resource retuning is permitted after target execution. This measures empirical sensitivity at the initial fixed-c candidate, not a rigorous parameter error bound, homoclinic existence, uniqueness, trajectory identity, Jones's printed coordinate, or the later continuation turn.
